name: Cardiff
tagline: Wales' capital of castles, rugby and the bay
summary: Cardiff is the lively capital of Wales, with a Roman-Norman-Victorian castle right in the centre. Tour the lavish Gothic rooms of Cardiff Castle, catch a rugby match at the Principality Stadium, explore the redeveloped Cardiff Bay, see the fairy-tale Castell Coch, and walk the open-air St Fagans museum of Welsh life.
seasonNote: Summer is mildest; rugby internationals in February and March fill the city.
arrival: Trains from London Paddington take about 2 hours; Cardiff Airport is 40 minutes away.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; buses and the water bus to the bay.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere. Tip about 10 percent in restaurants; not in pubs.
foodTip: Welsh cakes, Welsh rarebit, cawl (lamb stew) and laverbread.
buyTip: Welsh love spoons and Welsh wool blankets.
